sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select * from attention_board order by priority, kind, record

sections.title: Recommendations waiting
sections.sql: select crop, product, rate_per_ha, unit, qty_needed, stock, due, decision from recommendation_board where status = 'open' order by due

sections.title: Fields closed to re-entry
sections.sql: select * from reentry_board order by reentry_clear

sections.title: Crops
sections.sql: select crop, field, crop_type, harvest_planned, harvest_clear, unknown_hold, decision from harvest_readiness order by harvest_planned nulls last
sections.note: A record check only. Confirm withholding periods on the actual labels and your buyer's residue requirements before harvest.

sections.title: By crop
sections.sql: select * from margin_board order by season desc, crop
sections.note: Recorded input costs and harvested tonnes at the price entered on each crop. Excludes machinery, labour, freight, levies and anything not recorded here.

sections.title: Rainfall
sections.sql: select * from rainfall_board order by farm
